newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan to seek optional origin wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to seek optional origin wheat - trade.

text.p: Pakistan will tender on December 1 for about 225,000 tonnes to 270,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat , U.S. exporters said.

The wheat would be U.S. grade 2 or better soft white wheat in bulk plus/minus 5 percent buyer's option under the export credit guarantee program (GSM-102) and/or Australian white milling wheat in bulk plus/minus 10 percent buyer's option under the Australian credit program.
Delivery period was slated for December 11-31.
"The wheat is optional origin. Those are about the only two origins that will do it," one U.S. exporter said.
The 225,000 tonnes is the standard amount that Pakistan usually buys. It probably will be a combination of Australian and U.S. wheat, a second U.S. exporter noted.
